_comment: Raw std::env::set_var/remove_var calls in Rust test code that the test-env-writes guard (scripts/repo-guard test-env-writes, #360) accepts (#190). Each entry names the file, the variable names (or the argument as written) and why the write cannot use a test-unique name, the code under test's own env input, or temp_env. Prefer removing an entry to adding one.

entries.reason: Its own integration-test binary: the only test that reaches the HTTP path holds the file's TEST_LOCK and RestoreEnvVar puts the values back; the cache-hit test never reads them.

The released, immutable V77 migration reads this operator declaration from the process environment, so it cannot become an input. The test holds TEST_V77_UNOWNED_PROJECT_LOCK, and V77 reads the variable only when a V76 database holds an Issue with no creating session; any other fixture with one would fail without the declaration.
